# Disable SingleAxisScrollContainers

This virtual test suite runs the CSS sticky position tests with the `SingleAxisScrollContainers` feature explicitly disabled. This ensures that the current/default behavior of sticky positioning does not regress while the new independent axis behavior is being developed.
